title: OLEANDER Digital Product / Human-Centered Design Process v1.0 — Candidate
purpose: Define an authentic Digital Product / HCD professional process from human/service problem framing through research evidence, task/service modeling, experience concepts, information/content architecture, interaction state/recovery, prototype/integration, representative evaluation and in-use change without turning UI production skills, heuristic checks, accessibility tooling or one design-method lifecycle into universal authority.
scope_in: prototype and visual/technical integration for HCD evidence
scope_out: mandatory Design Thinking/Double Diamond/Lean UX lifecycle
Figma or another tool as process authority
automatic project Promotion or Current Knowledge
authority_position: CANDIDATE R-E professional-domain process under the existing Professional Domain Process Contract. It is not Current until the existing Evolution, independent review, authorized human adoption and Current readback chain closes; Current architecture must continue to report Digital Product / HCD PROCESS_OPEN meanwhile.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim depends on people understanding, deciding, acting, recovering, returning, completing tasks or moving through product/service states and therefore requires HCD/UX professional judgment or human evidence.
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable Current ceiling across project/source authority, human-evidence quality, population/task/context applicability, product-state truth, content authority, technical implementation truth, accessibility authority, R-F interface state, prototype fidelity, representative evaluation, actual readback and external approval governs.
not_triggered_when: artifact contains screens/typography/icons but makes no material human/task/service/interaction claim beyond static visual communication

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential HCD methods, human evidence, accessibility sources, product/service facts and technical behavior must pass existing task/claim Operational Mount rules; candidate skills/extensions do not self-promote to Current Knowledge.
required_methods: Current OLEANDER Design Quality/DD and Design Intelligence interaction/service lens
professional research protocol when consequential human evidence is collected
representative task evaluation appropriate to claim
standard_code_routes: Current applicable accessibility standards/legal/platform requirements when triggered; no copied fixed values become process defaults
precedent_case_routes: bounded HCD/product/service precedents only where task/context applicability is established
tool_knowledge_routes: Current Skill Resolver and UI/runtime capabilities when execution is required; no tool is HCD authority

stages.professional_question: What human, service or product-use problem is actually in scope, for whom and in which context, before solution assumptions become design authority?

stage_body_contract.knowledge_mount_rule: Use the stage knowledge_mount_requirement plus the Current task/claim-scoped Operational Mount; candidate support extensions remain bounded support and canonical knowledge bodies are not copied.
